settings.title: Sea the Difference: Our Ingredient Philosophy
settings.description: At Earth Harbor, we believe that beauty should be truly clean, safe, and results-driven. Our products are carefully formulated with nature’s best ingredients and grounded in science. We use only what your skin needs and exclude what it doesn’t. Everything we create is designed to promote the long-term health of your skin and the planet—because clean beauty means a clean conscience.

settings.text: Our Definition of Natural— Every ingredient is plant-based, mineral-based, or bio-identical, mimicking nature to deliver safe and effective results. All of our ingredients meet the standards for natural skincare as recognized by international guidelines. They come from renewable resources and only undergo changes through biological processes like fermentation, distillation, and cold processing. Our products are purely natural, minimally processed, and designed to be healthy for your skin.

Made With

We go beyond clean beauty by combining nature and science to create products that truly work for your skin. As a toxicologist-herbalist founded brand, we carefully select ingredients that are safe, effective, and beneficial for both your skin and the planet. We use pure, plant-based, bio-identical ingredients that are sustainably sourced, scientifically proven, and ethically formulated to provide long-lasting, real results.

settings.title: Pure, Premium Ingredients
settings.text: Certified organic, non-GMO, wildcrafted, and/or sustainably sourced for the highest efficacy and purity.

settings.title: Ocean & Earth Actives:
settings.text: Plant-based, bioidentical, mineral-rich botanicals, and upcycled oils, harnessing the power of both land and sea to nourish your skin.

settings.title: Eco-Conscious Packaging
settings.text: Zero-waste, plastic-neutral, recyclable, reusable, and plastic-free options to minimize environmental impact.

settings.title: Safe Formulations
settings.text: Clinically proven, third-party tested, pH-optimized, and designed for sensitive skin, with no fillers or harsh synthetics.
Subheading
We believe in the long-term health of both your skin and the planet, which is why our formulations focus on the highest-quality, sustainable ingredients—crafted with care for real, lasting results.

settings.title: Artificial Additives
settings.text:
• No Artificial Fragrances or Dyes
  • No Synthetic Musks
  • No PEGs (Polyethylene Glycols)
  • No Polysorbates (e.g., Polysorbate-20)
  • No EDTA & Related Compounds

settings.title: Harmful Preservatives
settings.text:
• No Parabens
  • No Phenoxyethanol
  • No Formaldehyde or Formaldehyde Releasers (e.g., Quaternium-15, DMDM Hydantoin)
  • No Methylisothiazolinone
  • No BHA/BHT
  • No Sodium Benzoate
  • No Chlorphenesin

settings.title: Silicones & Petrochemicals
settings.text:
• No Dimethicone or Other Silicones (e.g., Cyclopentasiloxane)
  • No Petroleum, Mineral Oils, or Paraffin
  • No Isododecane
  • No Polybutene
  • No Petroleum Jelly

settings.title: Common Allergens
settings.text:
• No Gluten or Soy Ingredients (Any soy compounds used are non-soy-derived)
  • Nut Oils Carefully Selected for Safety & Efficacy (Always listed for transparency)
  • No Dairy or Animal-Derived Ingredients (100% Vegan)
  • No Excessive Essential Oils (Gentle concentrations safe for sensitive skin, GC/MS tested for purity)

settings.title: Skin Irritants
settings.text:
• No Benzalkonium Chloride
  • No Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES)
  • No Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (SLS)
  • No Hydroquinone
  • No DEA/TEA/MEA (Ethanolamines)

settings.title: Environmental & Marine Toxins
settings.text:
• No Artificial UV Filters (e.g., Oxybenzone, Octinoxate, Avobenzone, Homosalate)
  • No Non-Biodegradable Plastic Microbeads
  • No Vinyl or Nylon
  • No Talc
  • No Nanoparticles

settings.title: Palm Oil
settings.text: • No Palm Oil (We use coconut derivatives instead of palm derivatives wherever possible and adhere to the strictest sustainable sourcing standards.)

settings.title: Unnecessary Fillers
settings.text: • We do not use ingredients that dilute performance or provide no benefit to your skin.

settings.title: Made Without
settings.text: Our founder—a toxicologist—leads the way in creating nontoxic products that prioritize safety for both people and the planet. We adhere to the world’s strictest ingredient standards, avoiding over 2,700 ingredients that are banned or restricted globally. Additionally, we exclude entire classes of harmful and unnecessary ingredients to ensure our formulations are truly clean, effective, and transparent.

Earth Harbor is committed to complete transparency, creating products that are gentle and high-performing. Our rigorous standards ensure every product is free from harmful ingredients, supports your skin’s health, and protects our planet.

settings.title: Sustainability at Every Step
settings.text: By keeping all aspects of our operations—from manufacturing and production to fulfillment and beyond—in-house, we control every touchpoint of our products. This includes everything from zero-waste packaging to ethically sourced ingredients, ensuring minimal environmental impact and maximum care.

settings.title: pH-Optimized & Bioavailable Formulas
settings.text: Designed for maximum absorption and gentle effectiveness for all skin types.
